prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide editorial illustration for a restrained Russian tutor platform landing page, contextual math exercise based on Dota 2.
Primary request: A playful, high quality illustrated scene of Dota 2 hero Pudge throwing his distinctive curved metal meat hook on a long chain across a river toward a distant enemy silhouette; instantly recognizable Pudge, but friendly and non-gory.
Scene/backdrop: atmospheric game-like stone river crossing, mossy ruined steps and soft forest foliage. Compose Pudge at the far left and the hook flying toward the right, clear visual story, 3:2 landscape composition. Include a real environment with depth rather than isolated geometric shapes.
Style/medium: polished painterly 3D game illustration with handcrafted surfaces, an elegant illustrated scene appropriate for an adult education website, readable silhouette, subtle depth of field. Material detail and sculpted shapes, not flat SVG primitives.
Lighting/mood: gentle cool daylight with coral highlights, lively, slightly whimsical.
Color palette: desaturated deep blue and sage, pale lavender sky, selective coral accents. Avoid dominant yellow or gold, oversaturation, or gloomy black.
Text: none. Leave the central river visually clear for the imagined distance, no baked text, math labels, logos or watermark.
Constraints: no blood, gore, weapons striking bodies, or official Dota logo. One coherent scene, not a collage. Visually evocative of an interest-based exercise rather than an advertisement for the game.
description: Prepared illustrative Dota 2 hook-distance exercise; not a live platform generation recording
